requiredImplementationPaths.reason: Consume the restored Want parameter only on APP_RECOVERY and transfer it into initial application state.
Expose the restored value as visible page state and save the latest user interaction rather than a fixed constant.

requiredOraclePaths.reason: Extend the existing upstream ohosTest entrypoint with cold-launch, abnormal-stop and recovery assertions.
Bind the UI Oracle to the exact visible state owner instead of accepting generic text from another page.

runtimeRequirements.description: Build, install and launch the pinned source on a HarmonyOS 6.0.2 API 22 phone emulator without physical-device fallback.
Prove that the selected emulator triggers onSaveState, APP_RECOVERY and restored Want delivery across a bounded abnormal stop and relaunch.
